plan.title: Immediate task completion persistence in festina-implement
plan.overview: Reorder the mark_task_complete logic within the execute_tasks step of festina-implement to run immediately after verification passes, rather than as a separate trailing substep. This ensures each task's completion is persisted to plan.xml before context exhaustion can occur, preventing bulk marking with identical timestamps.

approach.rationale:
The current structure has mark_task_complete as the 5th and final substep in the task execution loop. When implementing large plans, context exhaustion can occur before all tasks are marked, resulting in bulk marking with identical timestamps (as evidenced in plans 010 and 029).
By moving the marking logic inline with verification success, each task gets persisted immediately when it completes. This follows the principle of "persist early, persist often" for resumable workflows.
The change is structural (reordering) not functional - the same marking logic is used, just in a different location within the skill.

task.name: Move task completion marking inline with auto verification success
task.action: - Read SKILL.md - Locate the run_verification substep (lines 289-312) - Inside the branch for "command succeeds (exit code 0)", add the task marking logic immediately after "✓ Verification passed" output - The marking logic to add inline: ``` <action>Update plan.xml: Add `completed="true" completed_at="{ISO timestamp}"` to the task element</action> <action>Write updated plan file</action> <note>Task marked complete immediately after verification - ensures persistence before context exhaustion</note> ``` - This ensures FR1 (mark auto tasks immediately after verification succeeds)
task.verify: Manual: Inspect SKILL.md and verify marking logic appears inside the verification success branch
task.done: Auto verification success branch includes task marking logic

task.name: Move task completion marking inline with manual verification deferral
task.action: - Locate the branch for manual verification (task.verify starts with 'Manual:' OR task.type is 'manual') - Add the same task marking logic immediately after the deferral output line - The marking logic to add inline: ``` <action>Update plan.xml: Add `completed="true" completed_at="{ISO timestamp}"` to the task element</action> <action>Write updated plan file</action> <note>Task marked complete immediately - manual verification deferred but task is done from implementation perspective</note> ``` - This ensures FR2 (mark manual tasks immediately after deferral message)
task.verify: Manual: Inspect SKILL.md and verify marking logic appears in manual verification branch
task.done: Manual verification branch includes task marking logic

task.name: Remove the standalone mark_task_complete substep
task.action: - Locate the standalone mark_task_complete substep (currently lines 319-323) - Delete the entire substep block: ``` <substep name="mark_task_complete"> <action>Update plan.xml: Add `completed="true" completed_at="{ISO timestamp}"` to the task element</action> <action>Write updated plan file</action> <note>This enables resumability if implementation is interrupted</note> </substep> ``` - This removes the now-redundant trailing substep that could be skipped due to context exhaustion
task.verify: Manual: Verify mark_task_complete substep no longer exists as a standalone substep

task.name: Verify final structure
task.action: - Read the modified execute_tasks step - Verify the substep order is now: 1. show_task_context 2. execute_action 3. run_verification (with inline marking for both auto and manual branches) 4. confirm_done_criteria - Verify there is no 5th substep (mark_task_complete) - Verify marking happens before confirm_done_criteria in both code paths
task.verify: Manual: Read execute_tasks step and confirm structure matches requirements
task.done: execute_tasks has 4 substeps with inline marking in run_verification

testing.automated: None required - this is a skill definition file (markdown), not executable code
testing.manual: - Inspect the modified SKILL.md to verify marking logic placement - Future: Run festina-implement on a multi-task plan and verify each task gets unique timestamp
testing.regression: Verify the overall execute_tasks structure still makes logical sense
